# S1: normal session: plug in, charge two frames, unplug

# S1X: stress: S1 with back-to-back UART bytes

# S2: grid under-frequency: hold, then CRC-timed restart
./emu -d 0xF0 -i 0x01 -o 0x20 -i 0x02 -o 0x30 -t4 0x00A008FC -t4 0xCC771388 -o 0x30 -t4 0x00A008FC -t4 0x13EB1338 -o 0x60 -t4 0x00A008FC -t4 0x1B60134C -o 0x60 -t4 0x00A00816 -t4 0x398F1356 -o 0x60 -t4 0x00A00816 -t4 0xD9321356 -o 0x60 -t4 0x00A00816 -t4 0x5D4E1356 -o 0x30 -t4 0x00A008FC -t4 0x22701388 -o 0x30 -i 0x01 -o 0x20 -i 0x00 -o 0x00 -r4 0x000B3B00 -r2 0x0280 -r2 0xCBC4

# S3: corrupted frame and dropped frame each cost one frame
./emu -d 0xF0 -i 0x01 -o 0x20 -i 0x02 -o 0x30 -t4 0x00A008FC -t4 0xCC771388 -o 0x30 -t4 0x00A008FD -t4 0x0DE61388 -o 0x30 -t4 0x00A008FC -t4 0x7AAD1388 -o 0x30 -t4 0x00A008FC -t4 0x18BD1388 -o 0x30 -t4 0x00A008FC -t4 0xDAE51388 -o 0x30 -i 0x00 -o 0x00 -r4 0x0010D880 -r2 0x0300 -r2 0xC43B

# S4: meter link lost: two bad frames in a row latch FAULT
./emu -d 0xF0 -i 0x01 -o 0x20 -i 0x02 -o 0x30 -t4 0x00A008FC -t4 0xCC771388 -o 0x30 -t4 0x00A008FD -t4 0x0DE61388 -o 0x30 -t4 0x00A008FD -t4 0x7AAD1388 -o 0x80 -i 0x00 -o 0x00 -r4 0x00059D80 -r2 0x0144 -r2 0xB0AC

# S5: E-stop while charging latches FAULT until released and unplugged
./emu -d 0xF0 -i 0x01 -o 0x20 -i 0x02 -o 0x30 -t4 0x00A008FC -t4 0xCC771388 -o 0x30 -i 0x0A -o 0x80 -i 0x02 -o 0x80 -i 0x08 -o 0x80 -i 0x00 -o 0x00 -r4 0x00059D80 -r2 0x010C -r2 0x34C9

# S6: plug straight into CP C, then unplug while charging
./emu -d 0xF0 -i 0x02 -o 0x30 -t4 0x00A008FC -t4 0xCC771388 -o 0x30 -i 0x00 -o 0x00 -r4 0x00059D80 -r2 0x0100 -r2 0x71A4

# S7: frame exactly on every limit is billed; I_MAX+1 faults
./emu -d 0xF0 -i 0x01 -o 0x20 -i 0x02 -o 0x30 -t4 0x01400816 -t4 0x44BF1356 -o 0x30 -t4 0x014108FC -t4 0x207F1388 -o 0x80 -i 0x00 -o 0x00 -r4 0x000A1B80 -r2 0x0124 -r2 0x803D

# S8: ventilation (CP D) refused; CP E latches FAULT

# S9: invalid pilot code 7 latches FAULT with the CP-error flag
./emu -d 0xF0 -i 0x01 -o 0x20 -i 0x07 -o 0x80 -i 0x00 -o 0x00 -r4 0x00000000 -r2 0x0014 -r2 0xC1A7

# S10: replayed frame rejected, and the next one too -> FAULT
./emu -d 0xF0 -i 0x01 -o 0x20 -i 0x02 -o 0x30 -t4 0x00A008FC -t4 0xCC771388 -o 0x30 -t4 0x00A008FC -t4 0x0DE61388 -o 0x30 -t4 0x00A008FC -t4 0xCC771388 -o 0x30 -t4 0x00A008FC -t4 0x7AAD1388 -o 0x80 -i 0x00 -o 0x00 -r4 0x000B3B00 -r2 0x0244 -r2 0x1154

# S11 setup: leave IN = 0x02 for the reset at the start of S11
./emu -d 0xF0 -i 0x02 -o 0x30
